title: Capture a returned agent reflection
summary: The automatic Agent hook and registered manual route share the complete server parser and writer. A parent without an automatic receipt sends its captured response with the real project and role, retaining it until success. Receipts include parser, duplicate and persistence counts; incomplete work has a named refusal and recovery. Session, project and stable field-note request identity survive transport. Source tests establish the candidate behavior; installed carrying-release proof remains separate.
